import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_1.csv"
source2_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_2.csv"
source3_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_3.csv"

df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv(source2_path, index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv(source3_path, index_col=0)

# Step 1: JOIN Source3_67_1 and Source3_67_2 on "Wrestler"
join_1_2 = pd.merge(df1, df2, on="Wrestler", suffixes=('_1', '_2'), how='outer')

# Step 2: JOIN Source3_67_0 and Source3_67_3 on "Wrestler"
join_0_3 = pd.merge(df0, df3, on="Wrestler", suffixes=('_0', '_3'), how='outer')

# Step 3: JOIN the two joined results on "Wrestler"
# This step is implied by the aggregation referencing all four sources,
# so we join join_0_3 and join_1_2 on "Wrestler"
full_join = pd.merge(join_0_3, join_1_2, on="Wrestler", how='outer')

# Step 4: Group by "Wrestler" and aggregate sums of Wins, Losses, Draws from each source

agg_dict = {
    'Wins_0': 'sum',
    'Losses_0': 'sum',
    'Draws_0': 'sum',
    'Wins_1': 'sum',
    'Losses_1': 'sum',
    'Draws_1': 'sum',
    'Wins_2': 'sum',
    'Losses_2': 'sum',
    'Draws_2': 'sum',
    'Wins_3': 'sum',
    'Losses_3': 'sum',
    'Draws_3': 'sum',
}

# Rename columns in full_join to match keys in agg_dict
# The columns from df0 have suffix _0, from df3 have suffix _3, from df1 have suffix _1, from df2 have suffix _2
# After merges, columns are named like Wins_0, Wins_3, Wins_1, Wins_2 etc.

# But after merges, columns are named as:
# From join_0_3: Wins_0, Losses_0, Draws_0, Wins_3, Losses_3, Draws_3
# From join_1_2: Wins_1, Losses_1, Draws_1, Wins_2, Losses_2, Draws_2

# Check if columns exist, if not fill with 0 to avoid errors in aggregation
for col in agg_dict.keys():
    if col not in full_join.columns:
        full_join[col] = 0

# Perform groupby aggregation
result = full_join.groupby('Wrestler', as_index=False).agg(agg_dict)

# Rename columns to target schema names
result = result.rename(columns={
    'Wins_0': '2013 Wins',
    'Losses_0': '2013 Losses',
    'Draws_0': '2013 Draws',
    'Wins_1': '2014 Wins',
    'Losses_1': '2014 Losses',
    'Draws_1': '2014 Draws',
    'Wins_2': '2015 Wins',
    'Losses_2': '2015 Losses',
    'Draws_2': '2015 Draws',
    'Wins_3': '2016 Wins',
    'Losses_3': '2016 Losses',
    'Draws_3': '2016 Draws',
})

# Ensure column order as per target schema
target_columns = ['Wrestler',
                  '2013 Wins', '2013 Losses', '2013 Draws',
                  '2014 Wins', '2014 Losses', '2014 Draws',
                  '2015 Wins', '2015 Losses', '2015 Draws',
                  '2016 Wins', '2016 Losses', '2016 Draws']

result = result[target_columns]

# Convert all Wins, Losses, Draws columns to integer type (as target schema requires integer)
for col in target_columns[1:]:
    result[col] = result[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Write the result to the target CSV file
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/target_multisource.csv"
result.to_csv(output_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source tables with index_col=0
df0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
df1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
df2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
df3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/training_3.csv", index_col=0)

# Add year column to each dataframe according to source index
df0["Year"] = 2013
df1["Year"] = 2014
df2["Year"] = 2015
df3["Year"] = 2016

# UNION all source tables
df_all = pd.concat([df0, df1, df2, df3], ignore_index=True)

# GROUP BY Wrestler and Year, sum Wins, Losses, Draws
df_grouped = df_all.groupby(["Wrestler", "Year"], as_index=False).agg({
    "Wins": "sum",
    "Losses": "sum",
    "Draws": "sum"
})

# Pivot the table to get year-specific columns
df_pivot = df_grouped.pivot(index="Wrestler", columns="Year", values=["Wins", "Losses", "Draws"])

# Flatten MultiIndex columns and rename to match target schema
df_pivot.columns = [f"{year} {stat}" for stat, year in df_pivot.columns]
df_pivot.reset_index(inplace=True)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
target_columns = [
    "Wrestler",
    "2013 Wins", "2013 Losses", "2013 Draws",
    "2014 Wins", "2014 Losses", "2014 Draws",
    "2015 Wins", "2015 Losses", "2015 Draws",
    "2016 Wins", "2016 Losses", "2016 Draws"
]

# Some Wrestlers may not have data for all years, fill missing columns with 0
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in df_pivot.columns:
        df_pivot[col] = 0

df_pivot = df_pivot[target_columns]

# Convert all numeric columns to integer type (as in target schema)
for col in target_columns[1:]:
    df_pivot[col] = df_pivot[col].fillna(0).astype(int)

# Write output CSV
df_pivot.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_67/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
